auth.tagline: A quiet place for decks, review, and quizzes.
auth.encryptedNote: Your decks are encrypted at rest.

setup.title: Set up your study space
setup.intro: You are the first user. Choose a username and a passphrase of at least 10 characters.

login.title: Welcome back
login.intro: Sign in to unlock your decks and study data.
login.toRecover: Lost your passphrase? Recover with your key

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.intro: Enter the recovery key you saved at sign-up and choose a new passphrase.

register.title: Join with an invite
register.intro: You need an invite code from the server operator to create an account.
register.toLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
register.disclosure: Server-side encryption protects your content against disk or backup theft, other users of this computer, and other app users. The server operator can still technically access your data while you are logged in. If you lose both your passphrase and your recovery key, your data cannot be recovered.

recovery.title: Save your recovery key
recovery.intro: This is the only time this key will be shown. Store it somewhere safe: it is the only way back in if you forget your passphrase.

errors.short: Use at least 10 characters for your passphrase.
errors.savedRequired: Confirm that you have saved your recovery key.
errors.generic: That didn’t work. Please try again.
